_comment: Register the A2S2-OS MCP server with an MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, etc.). For Claude Desktop, merge this into claude_desktop_config.json. The server runs in the a2s2agent conda env and needs no API key of its own (the client supplies the model); it talks to a running A2S2-OS at A2S2_OS_URL (default http://localhost:8770). Edit the absolute path to mcp_server.py for your machine.
